route_round_trip_and_noop.criterion: same-state A/V replacement and zero-delta Q/K patch errors <= 1e-6

scope.embedding_boundary: Insufficient biological embedding requires a separate checkpoint trajectory, sibling-corpus contrast, or targeted-training test in which both behavior and the same causal route strengthen.
scope.intervention_family: local learned-P3 carrier surgery, L3H1 A/V replacement, and local L3H1 Q/K relocation
scope.negative_boundary: A negative result closes the declared checkpoint, behavior, context, and intervention family; it is not a biological no-go and does not exclude weak, distributed, shortcut-based, earlier-layer, nonlinear, context-limited, or alternative-head implementations.
scope.payload_boundary: Conditional value equivalence bounds the value-mediated contribution to Omega in both frozen routing contexts; it does not bound L3H1 value-vector changes or establish global payload semantics.

strongest_licensed_claim: The frozen development preflight did not license target carrier exposure, so no target mechanism conclusion is available.
